intro: Frigonais has come a long way from 1996 to today. From an idea that arose within the family circle to a company with over 120 employees. The headquarters of the company is in Niš, while the production facilities are located in the spa area, Kuršumlija. This ecological area is known for growing fruit, and that's where our raw material comes from. Our quality is recognized all over the world, which indicates exports worth around five million euros per year.
productionProgramText: Production consists of hot and cold processing, where the main products are frozen fruit, jam, fruit puree, thermostable mass, mass for fruit yogurt, as well as fruit fillings.
goalsText1: The company innovates year after year, discovers new technologies as well as new sustainable energy sources, which we are particularly proud of.
goalsText2: One of the key goals is the complete electrification of the vehicle fleet
goalsText3: Our vision is based on the placement of quality and healthy products that will be available to every consumer, regardless of their lifestyle and eating habits.
sustainabilityText1: The roof coverage with solar panels is 4500 square meters and in the future, the entire production supply with electricity from sustainable sources is planned.
sustainabilityText2: The company also owns a pool for processing waste water.
